_comment: WC2026 QUARTER-FINAL (QF97: winner of Paraguay-France vs winner of Canada-Morocco) -- first QF modelled. KNOCKOUT: no draw -- level after 90' -> extra time -> penalties, so the deliverable is who ADVANCES. Winner meets the Spain-Belgium winner in the semi-finals. Routes: France WON Group I with a PERFECT nine (GF 10: 3-1 Senegal, 3-1 Iraq, 4-1 Norway; rating 94), ROUTED Sweden 3-0 in the R32 (Mbappe brace) and controlled Paraguay 1-0 in the R16 (clean sheet vs a block). Devastating attack, solid defence, ruthless form. Morocco finished 2nd in Group C (1-1 Brazil, 1-0 Scotland, 4-2 Haiti; rating 83) and is THE in-form outsider of the tournament: held BRAZIL 1-1, ELIMINATED the Netherlands on penalties (1-1), then ROUTED co-host Canada 3-0 in the R16 with a clean sheet. Organized, defensively excellent, tournament-tough, with a real (if not elite-striker) attack. Class gap ~11 (94 vs 83) -> France the clear favourite, BUT the Canada-Morocco lesson applies: do NOT under-rate red-hot Morocco -- they are priced as a genuine quality side, not a block-minnow (Morocco lambda 0.85, NOT hard-trimmed). KEY texture: France's elite attack vs the best organized defence left -> a TIGHT, tense, low-to-moderate-scoring QF (1-0/1-1/2-0 shape). BTTS RULE: France a clear favourite and Morocco's attack is good-not-elite -> mild lean BTTS-No (52.8%), France clean sheet 42.7% -- but Morocco NOT zeroed (they scored on Brazil and put 3 past Canada). Draw/ET tail kept FAT (ET 26.3%, pens 13.6%): Morocco is a PROVEN penalty-winner (Netherlands) and grinder -- if it goes deep, the lottery favours nobody. France to a controlled win most likely; Morocco's upset equity is real and concentrated in the deep/ET/pens branches. Home = France (nominal; neutral venue). Cards not modelled (referee TBD).
